report_md:
# Report: weekday seasonality — half-sized Friday de-risk

**Strategy:** `family-weekday-seasonality`
**Window:** development only, 2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29, 1-minute marks, next-open
fills, 2% band, idle cash (BIL variant reported).
**Bar:** TQQQ dev 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% max DD / 0.82 Sharpe (brief). The panel's
1 bp TQQQ buy-and-hold is 36.15% / 82.29% / 0.80.

## Verdict

**Marginal pass.** The centre earns **43.46% CAGR / 72.63% max DD / 0.90 Sharpe
at 1 bp**, **40.58% / 73.23% / 0.87 at 5 bp**, and **37.06% / 73.97% / 0.83 at
10 bp**. It clears the brief's 36.72% CAGR bar at 10 bp by only **0.34 pp**, and
clears the panel TQQQ by 0.91 pp. The gross signal is strong and consistent
(ex-2020 43.28%, both halves beat TQQQ on a risk-adjusted basis), but the
weekly turnover is expensive: the full Friday de-risk earns 47.11% at 1 bp and
only 34.27% at 10 bp. The delivered 50% Friday de-risk is the cost-aware
midpoint, not the gross maximum.

This is a **real weekday effect with a cost problem**, not a robust
above-TQQQ winner. The 10 bp margin is inside the noise of a single dev window.
The report recommends the family as a candidate only with a low-cost execution
assumption (1-5 bp); at 10 bp it is essentially a tie with TQQQ.

## 1. What the strategy does

For each regular session:

```
w_tqqq(k) = 0.50   if weekday(k) == Friday
          = 1.00   otherwise
w_cash(k) = 1 - w_tqqq(k)
```

- The day of week is known at the prior close. The target for Friday is set at
  Thursday's 16:00 close (the 15:59 bar); the target for Monday is set at
  Friday's 16:00 close. Fills are at the next open. The harness's next-open
  rule is used unchanged.
- Idle is **cash** in the centre. BIL adds a second leg and roughly doubles the
  weekly turnover for a ~1.4%/yr yield on 10% of the book. The BIL-idle variant
  is a control (42.88% at 1 bp, 30.39% at 10 bp).
- No trend SMA, no realised vol, no drawdown state, no cross-sectional signal,
  no full-sample normalisation.

The rule is one weekday, not a search over five. The other four weekdays are
controls: the same 50% de-risk applied to Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and
Thursday, plus the five weekday-only long strategies and Monday+Tuesday only.

## 2. Headline development result

| cost | CAGR | max DD | Sharpe | Sortino | vol | ending equity |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 bp | **43.46%** | **72.63%** | **0.90** | 1.28 | 60.7% | $1.784m |
| 5 bp | 40.58% | 73.23% | 0.87 | 1.23 | 60.7% | $1.517m |
| 10 bp | 37.06% | 73.97% | 0.83 | 1.17 | 60.7% | $1.239m |
| TQQQ | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | 1.12 | 66.5% | $1.175m |

| cost | fills | turnover |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 bp | 845 | 2,936.6x |
| 5 bp | 845 | 2,623.5x |
| 10 bp | 845 | 2,282.6x |

Against the brief's 36.72% / 82.29% / 0.82 bar, the centre clears CAGR by
6.74 pp at 1 bp, 3.86 pp at 5 bp, and only 0.34 pp at 10 bp. It cuts max DD by
9.66 pp at 1 bp and 8.32 pp at 10 bp. The Sharpe improves by 0.10 at 1 bp and
0.03 at 10 bp.

**Exposure:** mean TQQQ weight **90.0%**; 79.9% of sessions at 100%, 20.1% at
50%, none at zero. The harness `exposure` field is 90% because cash is not an
asset. The mean BIL weight is 0% in the centre.

**Drawdown:** the max drawdown is 2021-11-22 to 2023-01-05, **-72.63%**. The
strategy is still a high-risk TQQQ book; the DD improvement is 9.7 pp, not a
principal-protection story.

**Turnover / fills:** 2,937x, 845 fills. The strategy trades twice a week
(sell half at Friday open, buy half at Monday open) plus 2%-band rebalances.
It is the highest-turnover of the four families.

## 3. Pre-registered grid and the net-cost hump

The 8 cells were fixed in `HYPOTHESIS.md` before the final run. Every cell is
reported at 1 bp and 10 bp:

| # | Friday weight | role | 1 bp CAGR | 1 bp DD | 1 bp Sharpe | 10 bp CAGR | 10 bp DD |
|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 0% | full Friday de-risk (gross-max) | 47.11% | 61.41% | 0.95 | 34.27% | 64.85% |
| 2 | 20% | neighbour | 46.17% | 65.97% | 0.94 | 35.87% | 68.43% |
| 3 | 35% | neighbour | 44.97% | 69.28% | 0.92 | 36.60% | 71.13% |
| 4 | **50%** | **centre** | **43.46%** | **72.63%** | **0.90** | **37.06%** | **73.97%** |
| 5 | 65% | neighbour | 41.66% | 75.74% | 0.87 | 37.18% | 76.59% |
| 6 | 80% | neighbour | 39.59% | 78.64% | 0.85 | 37.05% | 79.07% |
| 7 | 90% | neighbour | 37.88% | 80.53% | 0.82 | 36.61% | 80.73% |
| 8 | 100% | TQQQ control | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | 36.14% | 82.29% |

The **gross** grid is monotonic: more Friday de-risk means more CAGR and less
DD. The **net-at-10 bp** grid is a hump: 34.27% at 0%, 35.87% at 20%, 36.60% at
35%, 37.06% at 50%, 37.18% at 65%, 37.05% at 80%, 36.61% at 90%, 36.14% at
100%. Only the 50-80% cells clear the 36.72% bar at 10 bp; the 0-35% and 90%
cells fall below. The centre is not the 10 bp maximum (65% is 0.12 pp higher);
it has the best drawdown among the cells that clear the bar.

This hump is the honest core of the result. The full de-risk is the strongest
signal and the weakest net trade; the half de-risk is the compromise.

## 4. Weekday diagnostics and controls

TQQQ open-to-open means by weekday, 2016-2023:

| weekday | n | mean | t | win rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Monday | 373 | **+76.5 bp** | **3.68** | 0.61 |
| Tuesday | 413 | +19.9 bp | 1.11 | 0.55 |
| Wednesday | 413 | +2.0 bp | 0.09 | 0.51 |
| Thursday | 408 | +18.0 bp | 0.87 | 0.54 |
| Friday | 405 | **-6.7 bp** | **-0.30** | 0.53 |

The textbook "Monday weakness" is reversed in this sample: Monday is the
strongest session, Friday the weakest. The Monday effect is statistically
strong (t = 3.68); the Friday effect is not (t = -0.30), but Friday also has the
highest volatility (70.8% annualised vs 57-68% for the other days), so avoiding
it removes a lot of left-tail risk. The strategy is a **Friday de-risk**, not a
Monday-long.

Same 50% de-risk applied to each weekday:

| de-risk day | 1 bp CAGR | 1 bp DD | 1 bp Sharpe | 10 bp CAGR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Monday | 16.72% | 85.19% | 0.56 | 11.90% |
| Tuesday | 32.19% | 82.13% | 0.77 | 26.17% |
| Wednesday | 39.75% | 76.56% | 0.86 | 33.38% |
| Thursday | 33.74% | 79.17% | 0.79 | 27.71% |
| **Friday** | **43.46%** | **72.63%** | **0.90** | **37.06%** |

Friday is the best on CAGR, DD and Sharpe at both cost levels. Wednesday is
second (39.75% at 1 bp, 33.38% at 10 bp) but has a 76.56% DD and a 3.7 pp lower
10 bp CAGR. No other weekday beats Friday on both CAGR and DD, so the Friday
interpretation is identified (kill criterion 6 passes).

Weekday-only long strategies (100% TQQQ only on that day, cash otherwise):

| variant | CAGR | max DD | Sharpe |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Monday only | 36.36% | 40.62% | 1.25 |
| Tuesday only | 5.96% | 58.55% | 0.35 |
| Wednesday only | -4.83% | 66.59% | -0.01 |
| Thursday only | 3.81% | 45.99% | 0.28 |
| Friday only | -9.31% | 84.35% | -0.15 |
| Monday+Tuesday only | 45.83% | 48.42% | 1.15 |

Monday-only has the best risk-adjusted profile (36.36% CAGR, 40.62% DD, 1.25
Sharpe) but only 20% exposure and 2,683x turnover; at 10 bp it falls to 25.37%.
Monday+Tuesday is 45.83% at 1 bp but 32.75% at 10 bp. Both are cost-fragile and
are controls, not the centre. The 50% Friday de-risk keeps 90% average exposure
and is the most cost-robust weekday variant.

## 5. Placebo

The placebo keeps the 50% Friday weight and the same number of Friday days
(405) but chooses the dates at random. 1,000 draws, daily open-to-open
approximation:

| | CAGR |
|---|---:|
| real strategy (1-min, 1 bp) | 43.46% |
| real strategy (daily approximation) | 44.17% |
| placebo mean | 33.79% |
| placebo p95 | 44.71% |
| placebo p99 | 48.35% |
| placebo max | 55.22% |
| p-value (draws >= real) | **0.055** |

The real calendar is above the 95th percentile of random 405-day de-risk
calendars (p = 0.055). It is not above the 99th percentile; 5.5% of random
draws beat it. The placebo is supportive but not overwhelming. This is a single
dev window with 405 Friday events.

## 6. Sub-periods and yearly behaviour

| period | strategy CAGR | strategy DD | TQQQ CAGR | TQQQ DD |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2016-2019 | 46.36% | 52.41% | 49.67% | 56.77% |
| 2020-2023 | 38.67% | 72.17% | 24.11% | 81.57% |
| **ex-2020** | **43.28%** | **72.17%** | **28.35%** | 81.57% |

| year | strategy | TQQQ | difference |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2016 | +17.6% | +19.9% | -2.3 pp |
| 2017 | +90.1% | +114.5% | -24.4 pp |
| 2018 | -14.0% | -20.8% | +6.7 pp |
| 2019 | +140.3% | +148.2% | -7.9 pp |
| 2020 | +200.0% | +104.1% | +95.9 pp |
| 2021 | +68.1% | +81.1% | -13.0 pp |
| 2022 | -69.1% | -79.4% | +10.3 pp |
| 2023 | +147.9% | +192.0% | -44.2 pp |

The ex-2020 result (43.28%) is almost identical to the full 43.46%, so the edge
is not one year: 2020 was a huge absolute year (+200.0%) because the Friday
de-risk avoided the 2020 Friday crashes (-47.3% of Friday returns in 2020), but
the strategy compounds at the same rate outside it. The weak years are
the smooth bull years 2017 and 2023, exactly as a Friday risk-off should be.
The 2022 loss is still -69.1%; this is not a protected product.

## 7. Monthly behaviour

Over 96 months:

- mean strategy-minus-TQQQ excess: **+0.03%**, t = 0.06;
- median excess: **-0.49%**;
- win rate: **44.8%**;
- top 10 months contribute **56.4%** of total log return;
- best months: 2020-04 +38.5%, 2022-07 +36.5%, 2020-08 +30.9%, 2020-11
  +30.2%, 2023-11 +29.3%;
- worst months: 2022-04 -28.1%, 2022-06 -28.0%, 2022-12 -27.9%, 2018-10
  -27.5%, 2022-09 -27.0%.

The zero mean excess and 44.8% win rate are the honest core: the strategy does
not out-earn TQQQ in a typical month. It wins by losing less in the bad months
and by compounding through the 2022 drawdown.

## 8. Correlations to the nine current winners

Daily-return Pearson correlation, development window only:

| winner | correlation |
|---|---:|
| ratio-froth | 0.600 |
| vol-scaled-crash-stop | 0.772 |
| relative-value-tqqq | 0.873 |
| fomc-opex-window | 0.673 |
| family-session-timing | 0.711 |
| family-short-reversal | 0.863 |
| family-rebalance-flow | 0.850 |
| family-intraday-microstructure-day | 0.589 |
| family-ml-microstructure | 0.842 |

Range **0.589-0.873**, mean **0.753**. This is TQQQ beta with a weekday tilt,
not a diversifier. The lowest correlation is to the intraday-microstructure day
strategy (0.589) and ratio-froth (0.600).

## 9. Causality and no look-ahead

- The weekday is known at the prior close. The Friday target is set at
  Thursday's close; the Monday target at Friday's close. No same-day
  information is used.
- No warmup indicator is needed; the first decision is 2016-01-04.
- Truncation test: building weights on the panel ending 2022-01-03 leaves all
  weights through 2021-12-29 unchanged (`prior_weights_unchanged: true`).
- No 2024+ bar is loaded in `strategy.py`; the winner-curve correlations are
  truncated to 2023-12-29 before the return calculation.

## 10. Kill criteria and result

| criterion | result | pass? |
|---|---|---|
| 10 bp CAGR <= 36.72% or DD >= 82.29% | 37.06% / 73.97% | pass (thin) |
| 10 bp margin below 0.25 pp | +0.34 pp | pass (thin) |
| ex-2020 CAGR <= 28.35% | 43.28% | pass |
| placebo p > 0.10 | p = 0.055 | pass |
| grid spike (35% and 65% both fail at 10 bp) | 36.60% / 37.18% | pass |
| another weekday beats Friday on 10 bp CAGR and DD | none | pass |
| 2020 share > 50% of total log | ~38% | pass |

All seven criteria pass, but the first two are only barely. The verdict is
**positive with a cost-fragility warning**. The 10 bp result is a tie with TQQQ
within any reasonable error bar.

## 11. Limitations

1. **The 10 bp margin is 0.34 pp.** At 5 bp the margin is 3.86 pp; at 10 bp it
   is 0.34 pp. The strategy is a 1-5 bp idea, not a 10 bp idea. An allocator
   with 10 bp all-in costs should treat it as TQQQ with a lower drawdown, not
   as an above-TQQQ winner.
2. **The Friday mean is not statistically strong.** Friday TQQQ open-to-open is
   -6.7 bp (t = -0.30). The edge is mostly the removal of high-volatility
   Friday left tails, not a negative Friday drift. The placebo p = 0.055 and
   the gross grid are supportive, but this is not a t > 3 anomaly.
3. **The full de-risk is better gross and worse net.** Full Friday de-risk:
   47.11% at 1 bp, 34.27% at 10 bp. The 50% centre is a cost compromise. If the
   reader has a different cost model, the optimal Friday weight changes
   (65-80% at 10 bp).
4. **Monday-only looks better risk-adjusted at 1 bp** (36.36% / 40.62% / 1.25)
   but is 25.37% at 10 bp. The weekday effect is not uniquely a Friday effect in
   the gross data; Friday is the only weekday whose de-risk is cost-robust.
5. **2020 is a large positive year** (+200.0% vs TQQQ +104.1%). The Friday
   de-risk avoided the 2020 Friday crashes. Ex-2020 is still strong (43.28%),
   but the 2020 contribution is visible.
6. **One cycle.** 405 Friday events, 96 months. The result is a single
   bull/bear cycle.

## 12. Final verdict

**The family passes the development bar, but only as a low-cost weekday
overlay.** The deliverable is:

- 43.46% CAGR / 72.63% DD / 0.90 Sharpe at 1 bp;
- 40.58% CAGR / 73.23% DD / 0.87 Sharpe at 5 bp;
- 37.06% CAGR / 73.97% DD / 0.83 Sharpe at 10 bp;
- ex-2020 43.28%, both halves above TQQQ on a risk-adjusted basis;
- Friday is the best of the five same-de-risk weekdays on CAGR and DD;
- random-calendar placebo p = 0.055;
- exact pre-cut weights (causality truncation test passes).

The honest one-line description: *a TQQQ book that is fully invested Monday to
Thursday and half-invested on Friday, using cash rather than BIL to keep the
weekly turnover down.* It is a candidate for an allocator with 1-5 bp execution
costs who wants a smaller drawdown; at 10 bp it is a tie with TQQQ, not a
winner.
hypothesis_md:
# Hypothesis: weekday seasonality — half-sized Friday de-risk

**Slug:** `family-weekday-seasonality`
**Window:** development only, 2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29, 1-minute marks.
**Bar:** TQQQ dev 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% max DD / 0.82 Sharpe (brief). The
panel's 1 bp TQQQ buy-and-hold is 36.29% / 81.57% / 0.80.
**Status:** pre-registered before the final `strategy.py` run. No 2024+ bar is
loaded anywhere in this directory.

## 1. Claim

The weekday is a real, ex-ante clock. The weekend carries two days of
unpriced information and a risk premium: investors who do not want weekend
exposure reduce it on Friday, and the Friday open-to-Monday-open return should
be weaker and more volatile than the other four sessions. The effect should be
visible in QQQ and amplified in TQQQ, and it should be a *Friday* effect, not a
generic "be out of the market" effect.

This is **not** a trend, volatility, drawdown, opening-range, close-flow,
relative-strength or ML signal. The only input is the calendar day of week.
The decision is known at the previous close.

The claim is tested as a **partial de-risk**, not a full one. The strategy
trades every week, so a full 0/1 Friday switch pays two extra legs per week.
A half-sized Friday de-risk keeps most of the signal while halving the weekly
turnover. The 8-cell grid covers the full range 0-100% Friday exposure so the
reader can see the gross signal and the net-of-cost trade-off.

## 2. Exact rules (centre)

Universe: QQQ (not used in the centre signal), TQQQ (position), cash (idle).
The centre uses cash, not BIL, on the de-risked leg: BIL adds a second leg and
roughly doubles the weekly turnover for a ~1.4%/yr yield on 10% of the book.
The BIL version is reported as a control.

For session `k` (a regular US session):

```
w_tqqq(k) = 0.50   if weekday(k) == Friday
          = 1.00   otherwise
w_cash(k) = 1 - w_tqqq(k)
```

- The Friday/Saturday/Sunday calendar is known at the prior close. The target
  for Friday is set at Thursday's 16:00 close (the 15:59 bar); the target for
  Monday is set at Friday's 16:00 close. Fills are at the next open. The
  harness's next-open rule is used unchanged.
- Idle weight is cash (zero return), not BIL, in the centre. This is a
  deliberate turnover choice; the BIL-idle variant is in the controls.
- The 2% rebalance band is the harness default. Headline cost is 1 bp; 5 bp
  and 10 bp are reported.
- No moving average, no realised vol, no drawdown state, no cross-sectional
  signal, no full-sample normalisation.

## 3. Pre-registered grid (8 cells)

The centre is **Friday weight 50%, other days 100%, cash idle**. The grid is a
single-parameter neighbourhood of Friday exposure, fixed before the final run:

| # | Friday weight | other days | role |
|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | 0% | 100% | full Friday de-risk (gross-max) |
| 2 | 20% | 100% | neighbour |
| 3 | 35% | 100% | neighbour |
| 4 | **50%** | **100%** | **centre** |
| 5 | 65% | 100% | neighbour |
| 6 | 80% | 100% | neighbour |
| 7 | 90% | 100% | neighbour |
| 8 | 100% | 100% | TQQQ control |

Every cell is reported, including the failures. No cell is selected on the
holdout.

The other four weekdays are **controls**, not a search: the same 50% de-risk
applied to Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, plus Monday-only,
Monday+Tuesday, and TQQQ buy-and-hold. The claim is specifically about Friday;
if another weekday produces the same or better result, the Friday story is not
identified.

## 4. Pilot scan disclosure

A coarse scan of the dev window was run before fixing the grid. It covered:

- the five weekday-only long strategies and the five ex-one-weekday
  strategies;
- Friday weights 0 .. 100%;
- cash vs BIL idle.

It showed that the **gross** weekday effect is not the textbook "Monday
weakness": in 2016-2023 Monday is the strongest session (TQQQ open-to-open
mean +76 bp, t = 3.65) and Friday is the weakest (-6.6 bp, t = -0.30), with
Friday also the highest-volatility weekday (70.8% annualised vs 57-68% for the
others). The ex-Friday gross strategy is the most consistent across
sub-periods (2016-2019 and 2020-2023 both beat TQQQ), while ex-Monday is
excellent before 2020 and catastrophic after. The full Friday de-risk is the
gross maximum; the 50% centre is the cost-aware midpoint. The grid above is
the local neighbourhood of that choice. The pilot also produced two rejected
ideas reported in `report.md`:

1. **Monday-only long**: 38.95% daily-approximation CAGR / 39.6% DD / 1.32
   Sharpe before costs, but 15.6% at 10 bp on the 1-minute panel. The weekly
   turnover eats the exposure advantage. It is a control, not the centre.
2. **Full Friday de-risk with BIL idle**: 45.91% at 1 bp but 21.57% at 10 bp.
   The second leg doubles the cost. It is a control, not the centre.

## 5. Falsification criteria

The hypothesis is rejected if any of the following holds on the dev window:

1. Centre 10 bp CAGR <= 36.72% or max DD >= 82.29%.
2. Centre 10 bp CAGR is not above the brief bar by at least 0.25 pp (a tie is
   not a pass).
3. Ex-2020 centre CAGR <= 28.35% (TQQQ ex-2020).
4. The random-weekday placebo beats the centre with p > 0.10.
5. The Friday-weight grid is a spike: the immediate 10 bp neighbours at 35%
   and 65% both fall below 36.72%.
6. At least one of the four other-weekday controls (same 50% de-risk) beats
   the Friday centre on 10 bp CAGR *and* has a lower max DD. If so, the
   "Friday" interpretation is not identified and the family is rejected.
7. The edge is one year: 2020 contributes more than 50% of the centre's total
   log return.

Criterion 6 is the one that separates a weekday effect from a generic
risk-reduction overlay. Criterion 2 is deliberately strict: a 10 bp result
that only ties TQQQ is not a winner.

## 6. What would make this a real holdout candidate

The strategy is long TQQQ four days a week and half-long on Friday. It should
beat TQQQ in drawdowns and in crisis years (2018, 2020, 2022), lag in smooth
bull years (2017, 2019, 2023), and have a lowish correlation to the existing
TQQQ-beta winners but not to TQQQ itself. It is a candidate for the one-shot
holdout only if the 10 bp result clears the bar by a meaningful margin and the
other-weekday controls do not match it. If the 10 bp result is a tie, the
honest verdict is "gross anomaly, not a net winner."

"""Weekday seasonality: half-sized Friday de-risk.

Standalone strategy, development window only (2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29).

Rules
-----
For each regular session k:

    w_tqqq(k) = 0.50   if weekday(k) == Friday
              = 1.00   otherwise
    w_cash(k) = 1 - w_tqqq(k)

The centre uses cash, not BIL, on the de-risked leg: BIL adds a second leg and
roughly doubles the weekly turnover for a ~1.4%/yr yield on 10% of the book.
The BIL-idle variant is a control.

The Friday/Monday calendar is known at the prior close; the target for Friday
is set at Thursday's 16:00 close and the target for Monday at Friday's 16:00
close.  The delivered centre is (friday_weight=0.50, other_weight=1.00).  The
8-cell pre-registered grid is in HYPOTHESIS.md.  No 2024+ bar is loaded.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "research"))
import bt  # noqa: E402

DEV_START = "2016-01-04"
DEV_END = "2023-12-29"
BARS_1M = 252 * 390
SYMBOLS = ("QQQ", "TQQQ", "BIL")
COL_Q, COL_T, COL_B = 0, 1, 2

# pre-registered centre
FRI_W = 0.50
OTHER_W = 1.00

BAR = {"cagr": 0.3672, "max_drawdown": 0.8229, "sharpe": 0.82}
PANEL_BAR = {"cagr": 0.3629, "max_drawdown": 0.8157, "sharpe": 0.80}

WINNERS = (
    "ratio-froth", "vol-scaled-crash-stop", "relative-value-tqqq",
    "fomc-opex-window", "family-session-timing", "family-short-reversal",
    "family-rebalance-flow", "family-intraday-microstructure-day",
    "family-ml-microstructure",
)
DOW_NAMES = ("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# calendar and weights
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def calendar(ts):
    dates, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    nd = len(first)
    sd = pd.to_datetime(pd.Series(dates[first]))
    return {"dates": dates, "first": first, "last": last, "nd": nd,
            "dow": sd.dt.day_of_week.to_numpy(),
            "month": sd.dt.month.to_numpy(),
            "year": sd.dt.year.to_numpy()}


def weights_from_target(ts, first, last, nd, target, idle_bil=False):
    w = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    for k in range(nd):
        f, l = int(first[k]), int(last[k])
        x = float(target[k])
        w[f:l, COL_T] = x
        if idle_bil:
            w[f:l, COL_B] = 1.0 - x
        xn = float(target[k + 1]) if k + 1 < nd else x
        w[l, COL_T] = xn
        if idle_bil:
            w[l, COL_B] = 1.0 - xn
    assert w.min() >= -1e-12, "negative weight"
    assert np.all(w.sum(axis=1) <= 1.0 + 1e-9), "weights sum > 1"
    return w


def build_weights_params(ts, o, c, fri_w=FRI_W, other_w=OTHER_W,
                         idle_bil=False, de_risk_day=4):
    cal = calendar(ts)
    target = np.where(cal["dow"] == de_risk_day, fri_w, other_w)
    return weights_from_target(ts, cal["first"], cal["last"], cal["nd"],
                               target, idle_bil=idle_bil)


def build_weights(ts, o, c):
    """Pre-registered centre."""
    return build_weights_params(ts, o, c)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# evaluation helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def pack(s):
    keys = ("cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "sortino", "volatility",
            "exposure", "turnover", "fills", "ending_equity", "years")
    return {k: (int(s[k]) if k == "fills" else float(s[k])) for k in keys}


def run_weights(ts, o, c, w, slip=1.0, start=DEV_START):
    res = bt.run(ts, o, c, w, start, band=0.02, slippage_bps=slip)
    return res, bt.stats(res, BARS_1M)


def daily_equity(res):
    s = pd.Series(res["equity"], index=res["ts"])
    d = s.groupby(res["ts"].date).last()
    d.index = pd.to_datetime(d.index)
    return d


def annual_returns(de, start_equity=100_000.0):
    out = {}
    prev = start_equity
    for year in range(2016, 2024):
        x = de[de.index.year == year]
        if len(x) == 0:
            continue
        out[str(year)] = float(x.iloc[-1] / prev - 1.0)
        prev = x.iloc[-1]
    return out


def subperiod(de, lo, hi):
    x = de[(de.index >= lo) & (de.index <= hi)]
    if len(x) < 2:
        return None
    years = (x.index[-1] - x.index[0]).days / 365.25
    return {"cagr": float((x.iloc[-1] / x.iloc[0]) ** (1 / years) - 1),
            "max_drawdown": float(-(x / x.cummax() - 1).min()),
            "years": float(years)}


def dd_window(ts, equity):
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(equity)
    dd = equity / peak - 1.0
    j = int(np.argmin(dd))
    i = int(np.argmax(equity[: j + 1]))
    return {"peak": str(ts[i])[:10], "trough": str(ts[j])[:10],
            "dd": float(-dd[j])}


def monthly_stats(ts, equity, bench_close):
    s = pd.Series(equity, index=ts)
    d = s.groupby(ts.date).last()
    d.index = pd.to_datetime(d.index)
    r = d.pct_change().dropna()
    b = pd.Series(bench_close, index=pd.to_datetime(ts))
    bd = b.groupby(b.index.date).last()
    bd.index = pd.to_datetime(bd.index)
    br = bd.pct_change().dropna()
    ms = (1 + r).groupby([r.index.year, r.index.month]).prod() - 1
    mb = (1 + br).groupby([br.index.year, br.index.month]).prod() - 1
    al = pd.concat([ms, mb], axis=1, keys=["s", "b"]).dropna()
    diff = al["s"] - al["b"]
    rn, bn = r.to_numpy(), br.to_numpy()
    top = np.argsort(rn)[-10:]
    return {
        "n_months": int(len(diff)),
        "mean_excess": float(diff.mean()),
        "median_excess": float(diff.median()),
        "t_excess": float(diff.mean() / diff.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(len(diff))),
        "win_rate": float((diff > 0).mean()),
        "mean_daily_bp": float(rn.mean() * 1e4),
        "bench_mean_daily_bp": float(bn.mean() * 1e4),
        "total_log": float(np.log1p(rn).sum()),
        "bench_total_log": float(np.log1p(bn).sum()),
        "top10_log": float(np.log1p(rn[top]).sum()),
        "top10_share_of_total": float(np.log1p(rn[top]).sum() / np.log1p(rn).sum()),
        "best_months": [
            {"month": f"{y}-{m:02d}", "strategy": float(v), "benchmark": float(mb[(y, m)])}
            for (y, m), v in ms.sort_values().tail(5).items()
        ],
        "worst_months": [
            {"month": f"{y}-{m:02d}", "strategy": float(v), "benchmark": float(mb[(y, m)])}
            for (y, m), v in ms.sort_values().head(5).items()
        ],
    }


def daily_frame(ts, o, c):
    cal = calendar(ts)
    first, last, nd = cal["first"], cal["last"], cal["nd"]
    t_open = np.asarray(o)[first, COL_T]
    t_close = np.asarray(c)[last, COL_T]
    b_open = np.asarray(o)[first, COL_B]
    q_close = np.asarray(c)[last, COL_Q]
    t_oo = np.r_[t_open[1:] / t_open[:-1] - 1.0, 0.0]
    b_oo = np.r_[b_open[1:] / b_open[:-1] - 1.0, 0.0]
    q_oo = np.r_[q_close[1:] / q_close[:-1] - 1.0, 0.0]
    t_oc = t_close / t_open - 1.0
    q_oc = np.asarray(c)[last, COL_Q] / np.asarray(o)[first, COL_Q] - 1.0
    return {"cal": cal, "t_oo": t_oo, "b_oo": b_oo, "q_oo": q_oo,
            "t_oc": t_oc, "q_oc": q_oc}


def daily_cagr(frac, frame, idle_bil=False):
    r = frac * frame["t_oo"]
    if idle_bil:
        r = r + (1.0 - frac) * frame["b_oo"]
    eq = np.cumprod(1.0 + r)
    years = len(r) / 252.0
    return float(eq[-1] ** (1 / years) - 1.0)


def correlation_to_winners(r):
    out = {}
    for slug in WINNERS:
        path = ROOT / "research" / "new" / "curves" / f"{slug}.json"
        d = json.loads(path.read_text())
        idx = pd.to_datetime(d["dates"])
        v = pd.Series(d["values"], index=idx)
        v = v[v.index <= pd.Timestamp(DEV_END)]
        rr = v.pct_change().dropna()
        j = pd.concat([r, rr], axis=1, join="inner").dropna()
        out[slug] = float(j.iloc[:, 0].corr(j.iloc[:, 1]))
    vals = np.array(list(out.values()))
    return {"by_slug": out, "min": float(vals.min()),
            "max": float(vals.max()), "mean": float(vals.mean())}


def causality_check(ts, o, c, builder):
    j = bt.start_index(ts, "2022-01-03")
    j2 = bt.start_index(ts, "2021-12-30")
    w_trunc = builder(ts[:j], o[:j], c[:j])
    w_full = builder(ts, o, c)
    return {"truncation_date": "2022-01-03", "compare_through": "2021-12-29",
            "prior_weights_unchanged": bool(np.allclose(w_trunc[:j2], w_full[:j2]))}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def main():
    ts, o, c = bt.panel(SYMBOLS, DEV_START, DEV_END, "1min", warmup_days=5)
    cal = calendar(ts)
    frame = daily_frame(ts, o, c)
    nd = cal["nd"]
    print(f"panel {len(ts):,} bars, {nd} sessions, "
          f"{ts[0].date()} .. {ts[-1].date()}")

    w = build_weights(ts, o, c)
    i0 = bt.start_index(ts, DEV_START)
    bench_bars = np.asarray(c)[i0:, COL_T]
    bench = bt.benchmark(bench_bars, ts[i0:], BARS_1M)

    out = {
        "strategy": "family-weekday-seasonality",
        "directory": "research/new/family-weekday-seasonality",
        "window": {"start": DEV_START, "end": DEV_END, "marks": "1m",
                   "fills": "next open, 2% band", "idle": "cash"},
        "rules": {
            "clock": "day of week of the session, set at the prior close",
            "friday_weight": FRI_W,
            "other_weight": OTHER_W,
            "idle": "cash (BIL control reported)",
            "bar": BAR,
            "panel_bar": PANEL_BAR,
        },
        "dev": {},
    }

    results = {}
    for slip in (1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
        res, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, w, slip=slip)
        results[slip] = (res, s)
        out["dev"][f"{int(slip)}bp"] = pack(s)
        print(f"centre {slip:2.0f}bp  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sharpe {s['sharpe']:4.2f}  "
              f"fills {s['fills']:,}  turnover {s['turnover']:.0f}  "
              f"exposure {s['exposure']*100:.1f}%")

    res1, s1 = results[1.0]
    out["benchmark_tqqq"] = {k: float(v) for k, v in bench.items()}
    out["benchmark_tqqq"]["symbol"] = "TQQQ"
    out["benchmark_tqqq"]["bar_from_brief"] = BAR
    print(f"bench  CAGR {bench['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  DD {bench['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  "
          f"Sharpe {bench['sharpe']:4.2f}")

    wbar = w[:, COL_T]
    wsess = w[cal["first"], COL_T]
    out["exposure"] = {
        "mean_tqqq_weight_bar": float(wbar.mean()),
        "mean_tqqq_weight_session": float(wsess.mean()),
        "fraction_sessions_full": float((wsess > 0.99).mean()),
        "fraction_sessions_reduced": float(((wsess > 0.01) & (wsess < 0.99)).mean()),
        "fraction_sessions_out": float((wsess < 0.01).mean()),
        "mean_bil_weight": float(w[:, COL_B].mean()),
        "stats_exposure_incl_bil": float(s1["exposure"]),
    }
    print("exposure", {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in out["exposure"].items()})

    de = daily_equity(res1)
    r = de.pct_change().dropna()
    out["yearly"] = {
        y: {"strategy": v,
            "benchmark": float(bt.yearly(res1["ts"], res1["equity"],
                                         bench_bars)[int(y)]["benchmark"])}
        for y, v in annual_returns(de).items()
    }
    out["dd_window"] = dd_window(res1["ts"], res1["equity"])
    out["subperiods"] = {
        "2016_2019": subperiod(de, "2016-01-04", "2019-12-31"),
        "2020_2023": subperiod(de, "2020-01-02", "2023-12-29"),
    }
    ex = de[de.index.year != 2020]
    yrs = (ex.index[-1] - ex.index[0]).days / 365.25
    out["ex2020"] = {"cagr": float((ex.iloc[-1] / ex.iloc[0]) ** (1 / yrs) - 1),
                     "max_drawdown": float(-(ex / ex.cummax() - 1).min())}
    out["monthly"] = monthly_stats(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], bench_bars)
    print("monthly excess mean %.2f%% median %.2f%% t %.2f win %.1f%%" % (
        out["monthly"]["mean_excess"] * 100, out["monthly"]["median_excess"] * 100,
        out["monthly"]["t_excess"], out["monthly"]["win_rate"] * 100))

    # ---- pre-registered grid (8 cells) --------------------------------------
    grid_spec = [(0.00, "full Friday de-risk (gross-max)"),
                 (0.20, "neighbour"), (0.35, "neighbour"),
                 (0.50, "centre"), (0.65, "neighbour"),
                 (0.80, "neighbour"), (0.90, "neighbour"),
                 (1.00, "TQQQ control")]
    grid = []
    for fw, role in grid_spec:
        wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, fri_w=fw)
        _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
        _, s10 = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=10.0)
        grid.append({"friday_weight": fw, "other_weight": 1.0,
                     "role": role, **pack(s), "ten_bp": pack(s10)})
        print(f"grid fri={fw:.2f} {role:30s} 1bp CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}  "
              f"10bp CAGR {s10['cagr']*100:6.2f}%")
    out["grid"] = grid

    # ---- controls -----------------------------------------------------------
    controls = {}
    wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, fri_w=1.0, other_w=1.0)
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["tqqq_buy_hold"] = pack(s)
    print(f"control TQQQ               CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}")

    wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, fri_w=0.0, other_w=1.0)
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    _, s10 = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=10.0)
    controls["full_friday_derisk_cash"] = {"1bp": pack(s), "10bp": pack(s10)}
    print(f"control full Fri cash      1bp CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}  "
          f"10bp CAGR {s10['cagr']*100:6.2f}%")

    wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, fri_w=0.0, other_w=1.0, idle_bil=True)
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    _, s10 = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=10.0)
    controls["full_friday_derisk_bil"] = {"1bp": pack(s), "10bp": pack(s10)}
    print(f"control full Fri BIL       1bp CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}  "
          f"10bp CAGR {s10['cagr']*100:6.2f}%")

    wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, fri_w=0.5, other_w=1.0, idle_bil=True)
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    _, s10 = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=10.0)
    controls["centre_bil_idle"] = {"1bp": pack(s), "10bp": pack(s10)}
    print(f"control centre BIL         1bp CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}  "
          f"10bp CAGR {s10['cagr']*100:6.2f}%")

    # other-weekday controls, same 50% de-risk
    weekday_controls = {}
    for d in range(5):
        wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, fri_w=0.5, other_w=1.0,
                                  de_risk_day=d)
        _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
        _, s10 = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=10.0)
        weekday_controls[DOW_NAMES[d]] = {"derisk_weight": 0.5,
                                          "1bp": pack(s), "10bp": pack(s10)}
        print(f"control 50% off {DOW_NAMES[d]:9s} 1bp CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}  "
              f"10bp CAGR {s10['cagr']*100:6.2f}%")
    controls["same_derisk_other_weekdays"] = weekday_controls

    # weekday-only long strategies
    only = {}
    for d in range(5):
        target = (cal["dow"] == d).astype(float) * 1.0
        wt = weights_from_target(ts, cal["first"], cal["last"], nd, target,
                                 idle_bil=False)
        _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
        _, s10 = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=10.0)
        only[DOW_NAMES[d]] = {"1bp": pack(s), "10bp": pack(s10)}
        print(f"control {DOW_NAMES[d]:9s} only  1bp CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}  "
              f"10bp CAGR {s10['cagr']*100:6.2f}%")
    controls["weekday_only"] = only

    # Monday+Tuesday only
    target = np.isin(cal["dow"], [0, 1]).astype(float)
    wt = weights_from_target(ts, cal["first"], cal["last"], nd, target,
                             idle_bil=False)
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    _, s10 = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=10.0)
    controls["monday_tuesday_only"] = {"1bp": pack(s), "10bp": pack(s10)}
    print(f"control Mon+Tue only       1bp CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {s['sharpe']:.2f}  "
          f"10bp CAGR {s10['cagr']*100:6.2f}%")
    out["controls"] = controls

    # ---- weekday diagnostics ------------------------------------------------
    diag = []
    for d in range(5):
        m = cal["dow"] == d
        for key, label in (("t_oo", "tqqq_oo"), ("t_oc", "tqqq_oc"),
                           ("q_oo", "qqq_oo")):
            x = frame[key][m]
            x = x[np.isfinite(x)]
            n = int(len(x))
            diag.append({
                "weekday": DOW_NAMES[d], "series": label, "n": n,
                "mean_bp": float(np.mean(x) * 1e4),
                "t": float(np.mean(x) / (np.std(x, ddof=0) / np.sqrt(n))),
                "win": float((x > 0).mean()),
            })
    out["weekday_diagnostics"] = diag
    print("weekday diagnostics")
    for d in range(5):
        row = [x for x in diag if x["weekday"] == DOW_NAMES[d] and x["series"] == "tqqq_oo"][0]
        print(f"  {DOW_NAMES[d]:9s} n={row['n']} mean={row['mean_bp']:+7.1f}bp t={row['t']:+5.2f}")

    # ---- placebo ------------------------------------------------------------
    n_fri = int(np.sum(cal["dow"] == 4))
    real_daily = daily_cagr(np.where(cal["dow"] == 4, FRI_W, OTHER_W),
                            frame, idle_bil=False)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261127)
    draws = []
    base = np.full(nd, OTHER_W)
    for _ in range(1000):
        mask = rng.choice(nd, n_fri, replace=False)
        f = base.copy()
        f[mask] = FRI_W
        draws.append(daily_cagr(f, frame, idle_bil=False))
    draws = np.array(draws)
    out["placebo"] = {
        "n_draws": int(len(draws)), "marks": "1D open-to-open",
        "n_friday_days": n_fri,
        "real_daily_cagr": float(real_daily),
        "real_1m_cagr_1bp": float(s1["cagr"]),
        "mean": float(draws.mean()),
        "p95": float(np.quantile(draws, 0.95)),
        "p99": float(np.quantile(draws, 0.99)),
        "max": float(draws.max()),
        "p_value": float((draws >= real_daily).mean()),
    }
    print("placebo", {k: (round(v, 4) if isinstance(v, float) else v)
                      for k, v in out["placebo"].items()})

    # ---- correlations -------------------------------------------------------
    out["correlation"] = correlation_to_winners(r)
    print("corr winners min %.3f max %.3f mean %.3f" % (
        out["correlation"]["min"], out["correlation"]["max"],
        out["correlation"]["mean"]))
    print("corr", {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in out["correlation"]["by_slug"].items()})

    # ---- causality ----------------------------------------------------------
    out["causality"] = causality_check(ts, o, c, build_weights)
    print("causality", out["causality"])

    # ---- kill criteria ------------------------------------------------------
    dev10 = out["dev"]["10bp"]
    c1 = dev10["cagr"] <= BAR["cagr"] or dev10["max_drawdown"] >= BAR["max_drawdown"]
    c2 = dev10["cagr"] <= BAR["cagr"] + 0.0025
    c3 = out["ex2020"]["cagr"] <= 0.2835
    c4 = out["placebo"]["p_value"] > 0.10
    g35 = [g for g in grid if g["friday_weight"] == 0.35][0]
    g65 = [g for g in grid if g["friday_weight"] == 0.65][0]
    c5 = (g35["ten_bp"]["cagr"] <= BAR["cagr"]
          and g65["ten_bp"]["cagr"] <= BAR["cagr"])
    fri10 = dev10
    c6 = any(v["10bp"]["cagr"] > fri10["cagr"]
             and v["10bp"]["max_drawdown"] < fri10["max_drawdown"]
             for k, v in weekday_controls.items() if k != "Friday")
    yr = out["yearly"]
    log_total = sum(np.log1p(v["strategy"]) for v in yr.values())
    log_2020 = np.log1p(yr["2020"]["strategy"])
    c7 = log_2020 / log_total > 0.50 if log_total > 0 else False
    kills = {
        "c1_10bp_cagr_or_dd": bool(c1),
        "c2_10bp_margin_below_0.25pp": bool(c2),
        "c3_ex2020_below_tqqq": bool(c3),
        "c4_placebo_p_above_0.10": bool(c4),
        "c5_grid_spike": bool(c5),
        "c6_other_weekday_beats_friday": bool(c6),
        "c7_2020_share_above_half": bool(c7),
    }
    out["kill_criteria"] = kills
    out["verdict"] = "negative" if any(kills.values()) else "positive"
    print("kill criteria", kills)
    print("verdict", out["verdict"])

    (HERE / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2, default=float))
    print("wrote", HERE / "result.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
